verdict.rationale: Gide's own Intellectual Property page describes IP litigation and names venues: the firm claims top-tier IP litigation expertise, including cross-border patent and trademark cases. It says it can argue before the Unified Patent Court in French and English, and handles trade mark and design disputes before all French and EU IP courts and offices. Missing for 10: specific case outcomes or named matters, evidence of trade-secret litigation (trade secrets appear only in the practice scope), independent corroboration of the litigation record.
